name: News shows
description: Local news breaks as virtual shows: headlines from your RSS or Atom feeds, with the weather, the markets, scores, a local map (rain radar, and traffic with a TomTom key) and lottery results, in a teletext, news desk, 24-hour cable news or 80s/90s local station look. Optionally read out by any installed voice (Piper, TikTok, MiniMax) over your own music. A 24/7 news channel, or short news breaks between shows. Needs Chrome or Edge on this computer.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: each show on air is a hidden browser drawing the page without a graphics chip, plus a live encode. The teletext look is the lightest; capture at about 8 frames per second.

settings.label: Fetch the news again every (minutes)
settings.description: How often each show's feeds and data are fetched while it's in use (5 to 240). New voice-overs are made each time, so with a paid voice keep this longer.

settings.label: TomTom API key
settings.description: For traffic on the map segment (flow colours and incidents). Free from developer.tomtom.com. Without one the map shows rain radar only.

settings.label: Browser
settings.description: Chrome, Edge or Chromium, run hidden to draw the news. Leave empty to find one automatically.
settings.lowPowerNote: On Raspberry Pi OS, install chromium (sudo apt install chromium); Chrome and Edge have no ARM Linux builds.

settings.label: ffmpeg
settings.description: Leave empty to use the ffmpeg set under App settings.

settings.label: Stream address
settings.description: How ErsatzTV reaches this scheduler. Leave empty unless ErsatzTV runs on another machine or in a container.

settings.label: Capture frames per second
settings.description: How often the page is captured (5 to 30). The ticker scrolls more smoothly higher up; the stream's own frame rate is set under App settings → Hardware and video encoding.

settings.label: Keep a show running after it goes off air (seconds)
settings.description: So back-to-back news breaks don't restart the browser each time. A break that starts after this begins again from the top.

settings.label: Draw animations at the capture rate
settings.description: The hidden browser moves the page's animations (the ticker, the transitions) on only as often as it's captured, instead of redrawing 60 times a second for frames that are never used. They move at the same speed. Turn off only if something stops or stutters.
